defect: The first prefix replay implementation used a mutating DSU find for read-only state features. Querying an unseen candidate endpoint inserted singleton nodes, so later events at the same ready_frame appeared to have a different state.
impact: The causal replay contract stopped before acceptance; no model training or MOT result was produced from the defective implementation.
repair: Added a non-mutating _peek path for component-size and same-component feature queries; only accepted historical edges can create DSU nodes.

checks: source and input SHA-256 values loaded for all 20 train pairs
same-frame state digest is invariant after candidate feature queries
all 20 pairs have zero future evidence-frame and future-commit violations
positive rows remain candidate-present and legal-prefix labeled

scientific_status: No official-val/test metric or novelty claim is authorized by this contract.
